title: acq Neutral Kit Schema (hybrid/v1)
description: Schema for the neutral, backend-agnostic acq kit spec (schemaVersion: "hybrid/v1"). Captures the declarative parts of an isolation-sandbox mixin kit (network egress, files to drop, lifecycle commands, agent context) in a vocabulary shared across acq backends (sbx, msb, ppp), plus per-backend shortcuts and extras. See integrations/isolation/docs/decisions/0001-neutral-hybrid-v1-acq-kits.md and the acq-design.md exploration (quickstart repo) for rationale.

kind.description: Only mixin kits are modeled by hybrid/v1 today (they layer onto a base agent sandbox).

name.description: Kit identifier. Kebab-case, 1-64 chars, starts/ends alphanumeric. SHOULD equal the containing directory name.

description.description: One-paragraph summary of what the kit does.

allow.description: Outbound egress allow-list. Hostnames, optionally with :port (default 443). Each backend maps these to its native egress primitive.

files.description: Files to drop into the guest. Each backend materializes these via its native file-drop mechanism.

mode.description: Octal file mode as a string, e.g. "0644".

source.description: Path (relative to the kit dir, under files/) to the payload file. Preferred over inline content for multi-line payloads. Mutually exclusive with content.

content.description: Inline file content. Use for short blobs (e.g. a PEM); prefer source for larger payloads. Mutually exclusive with source.

phase.description: Optional lifecycle phase hint for when the file is written (default: written before commands run).

commands.description: Lifecycle commands, in neutral phase vocabulary. Adapters map each phase to the backend's native hook.

phase.description: install = root, create-time once; initFiles = agent uid, every start after base setup; startup = every start after initFiles.

user.description: Numeric uid to run as (e.g. "0" root, "1000" agent). Defaults are phase-specific if omitted.

command.description: argv form (list of strings). To run a shell snippet, use ["sh", "-c", "..."].

agentContext.description: Markdown context surfaced to the agent (written to the agent context root by each backend).

backend_shortcuts.description: Per-backend native primitives that replace the declarative caps/files/commands path for that backend. Adapters check this first; when a shortcut is present for the active backend, caps/files/commands are skipped for this kit. NOTE: each backend value is an unconstrained object (human-review-only; the shape is NOT schema-enforced). 'ppp' is a reserved slot for the in-flight Podman backend (Phase 3); 'sbx' and 'msb' have live consumers.

backend_extras.description: Free-form per-backend configuration the neutral spec does not model. Each backend value is an unconstrained object: it is surfaced in-spec so a human reviewer sees it, but its shape is human-review-only and NOT schema-enforced. 'ppp' is reserved for the in-flight Podman backend (Phase 3).
